edits.old_text: Administrative access to ordinary system entities. Admin is linked to Engineer. Admin/SuperAdmin handle User Management, Engineer information, LGU records, and EngineerLGU assignments. Referenced UserAccounts are deactivated through IsActive = FALSE rather than hard-deleted.
edits.new_text: Administrative access to ordinary system entities. New Admin accounts require an Active, available Engineer profile. Existing unlinked Admin accounts remain temporarily supported. An Admin may manage their own record only with valid Active profile/LGU eligibility. Admin/SuperAdmin handle User Management, Engineer information, LGU records, and EngineerLGU assignments. Referenced UserAccounts are deactivated through IsActive = FALSE rather than hard-deleted.

edits.old_text: After a RoadCoverage exists, the creator selects/fetches it and creates the MaintenanceProject. For an Engineer account, Create/Update is allowed when that Engineer has an active EngineerLGU assignment to the LGU referenced by the selected RoadCoverage. Working title: Place-Place-Place Maintenance Project.
edits.new_text: After a RoadCoverage exists, the creator selects/fetches it and creates the MaintenanceProject. For an Engineer account, Create/Update is allowed when that Engineer has an active EngineerLGU assignment to the LGU referenced by the selected RoadCoverage. Working title: Place-Place-Place Maintenance Project. The Engineer UserAccount and linked Engineer profile must also be Active. Admin/SuperAdmin may create a project without assigning a manager; municipality comes from RoadCoverage, and manager assignment belongs to each MaintenanceRecord.

edits.old_text: A MaintenanceProject may have multiple MaintenanceRecords across years and quarters. Each stores its responsible ManagingEngineer, quarter, dates, duration, status and description. One record per project/year/quarter is recommended, pending confirmation; this does not require all four quarters. CompleteDate is required for Completed and must be on/after StartDate; reopening clears it and is audited. Only the assigned Engineer may edit; Admin/SuperAdmin may override.
edits.new_text: A MaintenanceProject may have multiple MaintenanceRecords across years and quarters. An authorized Engineer may select any available Q1, Q2, Q3 or Q4. Fixed Q1/Q3 or Q2/Q4 pairing is not mandatory. Duplicate ProjectID + MaintenanceYear + Quarter entries are prohibited; no requirement exists to create all four quarters or to create future placeholder records. Each record stores its current ManagingEngineer, quarter, dates, positive estimated duration, description and status Ongoing or Completed. CompleteDate is required for Completed and must be on/after StartDate; reopening clears it and is audited. The assigned Engineer may edit subject to active account/profile/LGU authorization; Admin/SuperAdmin may override. A properly linked and LGU-authorized Admin may manage their own record.

edits.old_text: MonthlyUpdate belongs to MaintenanceRecord, not directly to MaintenanceProject. UpdateMonth uses YYYY-MM. The current confirmed data rule allows at most one update for the same MaintenanceRecord and month, enforced by UNIQUE(MaintenanceID, UpdateMonth).
edits.new_text: MonthlyUpdate belongs to MaintenanceRecord, not directly to MaintenanceProject. UpdateMonth uses YYYY-MM. The current confirmed data rule allows at most one update for the same MaintenanceRecord and month, enforced by UNIQUE(MaintenanceID, UpdateMonth). Quarterly MaintenanceRecords and MonthlyUpdates are distinct: choosing a quarter does not create MonthlyUpdates, and monthly reports do not satisfy or create quarterly maintenance occurrences.
